name: Shiva
light: Inner stillness so deep that nothing can shake you.
shadow: You can withdraw so far that the world can't reach you.
lesson: Destruction is also a beginning. Let go of what has ended.

name: Vishnu
light: You hold everything in balance and protect it.
shadow: Steering everything from behind the scenes can turn into control.
lesson: Return as often as you're needed, in whatever form is needed.

name: Brahma
e: The creator, born from a lotus
light: You build worlds out of ideas.
shadow: Pride in your creation; Brahma once lied to claim he'd found the end of Shiva's pillar of light.
lesson: Creating something doesn't make you its master.

name: Lakshmi
light: You bring abundance and make everyone feel welcome.
shadow: Comfort can make you restless when life gets hard.
lesson: Fortune stays where there is goodness and effort.

name: Saraswati
light: A clear, creative mind that learns endlessly.
shadow: You can drift above the messy, emotional world.
lesson: Knowledge is the one wealth that grows when you give it away.

name: Parvati
light: Devotion so patient it won the heart of Shiva himself.
shadow: You may wait too long for someone to see you.
lesson: Tapas, steady inner effort, can move even a mountain god.

name: Durga
light: You stand up to anyone for those who can't fight back.
shadow: Always being the warrior is exhausting.
lesson: Strength is at its most sacred when it protects.

name: Kali
light: Fearless truth that cuts through every illusion.
shadow: Your fury can keep going after the battle is won.
lesson: Face the darkness and it loses its power over you.

name: Ganesha
light: Wise, witty and always able to find a way through.
shadow: Being everyone's problem-solver can leave your own needs last.
lesson: Circling your parents can be circling the world. Wisdom beats speed.

name: Kartikeya
light: Drive, discipline and the courage to lead from the front.
shadow: When you lose, you may walk away from everyone.
lesson: Victory needs wisdom as much as speed.

name: Hanuman
light: Limitless strength powered by loyalty.
shadow: You forget your own power until someone reminds you.
lesson: Serve something greater and you'll discover what you can do.

name: Krishna
light: Charm, play and a strategist's mind.
shadow: Your clever games can leave others confused or hurt.
lesson: Do your duty without clinging to the result.

name: Rama
light: Your word is unbreakable and people trust you completely.
shadow: Putting duty first can wound the people closest to you.
lesson: Integrity is a choice you make again every single day.

name: Radha
light: Love so complete it becomes worship.
shadow: You can lose yourself entirely in someone else.
lesson: The purest love asks for nothing back.

name: Indra
light: A natural ruler who loves life's pleasures.
shadow: You're always afraid someone will take your throne.
lesson: A crown held with fear is never really yours.

name: Surya
light: Utterly reliable. You show up every day without fail.
shadow: Your intensity can burn those who come too close.
lesson: Give light to everyone, without choosing who deserves it.

name: Sita
light: Quiet strength that endures every trial with dignity.
shadow: You keep proving yourself to people who should already trust you.
lesson: Know when to stop enduring and return to yourself.

name: Lakshmana
light: Fierce loyalty; you'd follow your person into the forest for fourteen years.
shadow: Your temper flares on behalf of the people you love.
lesson: Loyalty shows most in the small, daily things.

name: Bharata
e: The brother who refused the throne
light: Humility and duty over personal gain.
shadow: You may deny yourself even what you rightly deserve.
lesson: Greatness can mean holding the place for someone else.

name: Ravana
light: Brilliant scholar, great king and Shiva's greatest devotee.
shadow: Pride and desire that ignore every warning.
lesson: Genius without humility destroys itself.

name: Vibhishana
light: You choose what's right even when your own family is wrong.
shadow: Others may call you a traitor for it.
lesson: Dharma sometimes means walking away from your own side.

name: Kumbhakarna
e: The giant who slept for months
light: Big-hearted loyalty to family, whatever the cost.
shadow: You know the truth but follow anyway, or you sleep through it.
lesson: Loyalty without judgement can carry you to ruin.

name: Kaikeyi
e: The queen who demanded Rama's exile
light: Fierce, protective love for your own.
shadow: Fear and whispered advice can turn that love into cruelty.
lesson: Be careful whose voice you let into your heart.

name: Arjuna
light: Focus, talent, and the humility to ask for guidance.
shadow: Doubt can freeze you at the moment of action.
lesson: When you're lost, choose a true guide and listen.

name: Karna
light: Unmatched generosity and loyalty to whoever stood by you.
shadow: Old wounds of rejection make you defend the wrong side.
lesson: Your loyalty is precious, so give it to someone worthy.

name: Bhishma
light: Iron will. Your vow is your identity.
shadow: You may keep a promise even while injustice happens in front of you.
lesson: A vow should serve dharma, not replace it.

name: Yudhishthira
light: Honest, calm and fair-minded.
shadow: A single weakness, like his dice game, can undo everything.
lesson: Know your weak spot before someone else uses it.

name: Bhima
light: Huge strength, a big appetite and a bigger heart for family.
shadow: You act on rage before thinking.
lesson: Strength guided by love is unstoppable.

name: Draupadi
light: Fierce dignity; you demand justice and don't let it go.
shadow: Unhealed anger can drive you toward destruction.
lesson: Call out wrong, and find the divine help that answers you.

name: Duryodhana
light: Fierce loyalty to friends and never giving up.
shadow: Jealousy that refuses to share anything.
lesson: Envy turns every gift you have into a weapon against you.

name: Shakuni
light: A brilliant strategist who plays the long game.
shadow: Revenge has become your whole purpose.
lesson: A grudge you carry for years ends up owning you.

name: Drona
light: A master who shapes greatness in others.
shadow: Favouritism and attachment cloud your fairness.
lesson: A true teacher's duty is to every student.

name: Kunti
light: Endless resilience. You hold the family together.
shadow: Secrets kept too long cause the deepest pain.
lesson: The truth told late still costs less than the truth never told.

name: Gandhari
light: Total commitment to your vows and your people.
shadow: Choosing not to see what your loved ones are doing.
lesson: Love sometimes means opening your eyes, not closing them.

name: Abhimanyu
e: The young hero of the chakravyuha
light: Brave beyond your years; you charge in where others hesitate.
shadow: Knowing how to enter a battle, but not how to leave it.
lesson: Courage needs a way out as well as a way in.

name: Ekalavya
light: Devotion and discipline that need no one's permission.
shadow: You give too much to those who never deserved it.
lesson: Your devotion is a gift. Choose carefully who receives it.

name: Vidura
light: Clear, honest advice, even to kings.
shadow: Speaking the truth is lonely when nobody listens.
lesson: Say what's right even if you're ignored; history will remember it.

name: Prahlada
e: The devoted son of a demon king
light: Faith that survives fire, poison and your own father.
shadow: Standing alone against the people who raised you.
lesson: True faith doesn't depend on who surrounds you.

name: Mahabali
light: A generous ruler whose people were truly happy.
shadow: Pride in your own generosity.
lesson: Give with humility, and even losing becomes a blessing.

name: Hiranyakashipu
e: The demon king who wanted to be God
light: Unbreakable willpower and endurance.
shadow: You want to be worshipped rather than to worship.
lesson: No loophole protects you from your own arrogance.

name: Mahishasura
light: Raw, relentless force and ambition.
shadow: Thinking power entitles you to everything.
lesson: Brute force always meets something stronger.

name: Kamsa
light: A sharp sense of danger and a will to survive.
shadow: Fear makes you cruel to anyone who might threaten you.
lesson: What you try hardest to control often ends up controlling you.

name: Shukracharya
light: Deep knowledge and loyalty to the underdogs.
shadow: Your wisdom serves the side you chose, right or wrong.
lesson: Knowledge is only as good as the cause it serves.

name: Vishwamitra
e: The king who became a sage
light: Fierce ambition that transforms you completely.
shadow: Rivalry and temper keep breaking your progress.
lesson: The hardest kingdom to conquer is your own ego.

name: Vashishtha
light: Peace so deep that even attacks don't disturb you.
shadow: Your calm can look like distance to others.
lesson: Forgiveness is a strength, not a weakness.

name: Narada
light: Joyful devotion and a gift for setting things in motion.
shadow: Your mischief can start fires you didn't mean to.
lesson: Even the chaos you stir can serve a higher purpose.

name: Valmiki
e: The robber who wrote the Ramayana
light: The power to completely remake yourself.
shadow: The past you left behind may still haunt you.
lesson: No one is beyond transformation.

name: Vyasa
e: Compiler of the Vedas and the Mahabharata
light: You see the whole story and record it truthfully.
shadow: Watching events unfold that you could have stopped.
lesson: Truth told fully includes the parts we'd rather hide.

name: Durvasa
light: Spiritual power and zero tolerance for disrespect.
shadow: One careless word from someone and you curse them for life.
lesson: Power without patience wounds more than it teaches.
